How to order

How do I order a game?

Open the game, choose PC, PS4 or PS5, then tap the WhatsApp or Telegram button, or scan a QR code. The app opens with your message ready.

How much does a game cost?

The price is shown on each game. If a game says "Ask for price", send us the message and we reply with the price.

How do I pay and receive my game?

Chat with us on WhatsApp or Telegram and we explain the payment methods and how you get your game.

I can't find my game

Search by title, or message us on WhatsApp and we will check for you.
